About this item

  • PODIATRIST-CERTIFIED SUPPORT: Arch Fit insole system provides exceptional arch support, developed from 120,000 foot scans for optimal comfort in these slip on shoes for women
  • EASY SLIP-ON DESIGN: These slip on sneakers for women feature a convenient No Tie Fit design with tied-off laces that never come untied
  • PREMIUM COMFORT FEATURES: Removable insole molds to your foot while the lightweight cushioned midsole reduces shock and increases weight dispersion for these womens slip on shoes
  • VEGAN-FRIENDLY CONSTRUCTION: Canvas upper and 100% vegan materials make these fashion sneakers both stylish and environmentally conscious
  • VERSATILE STYLE: Flexible traction outsole and casual design make these perfect for everyday wear, from running errands to all-day comfort

From the brand

From the manufacturer

WHY MILLIONS CHOOSE SKECHERS

Comfort That Moves With You 

Our signature designs are built with comfort in mind—delivering lasting support and cushion no matter where life takes you.

Innovation Across Every Style 

From hands-free wear to cushioned tech, Skechers brings comfort and innovation to a wide selection of shoes and apparel for every lifestyle.

Wide Variety for Every Style 

From sneakers to casual wear, Skechers offers a broad range of shoes and apparel for men, women, and kids—crafted for style and comfort.

Style & Comfort, No Extra Cost

Experience the best in quality, comfort, and versatility, all while enjoying the value Skechers brings across a variety of footwear and apparel.

  • Are Skechers just casual shoes, or do they offer styles for other needs too?

    Skechers offers everything from everyday sneakers and dress-casual styles to athletic, work, walking, and even performance footwear—plus apparel and accessories to match.

  • What makes Skechers shoes so comfortable?

    Skechers is known as the comfort technology company. Many of our styles include features like Air-Cooled Memory Foam, Arch Fit, and Luxe Foam for all-day support.

  • Does Skechers offer options for both men and women?

    Yes! Skechers designs shoes, clothing, and accessories for men, women, and kids—with inclusive sizing, styles, and fits for every lifestyle.

  • Are Skechers good for walking or being on your feet all day?

    Absolutely! Many Skechers styles are made with lightweight materials and cushioned insoles—perfect for long hours of standing or walking.

  • Are Skechers products affordable?

    Yes! Skechers offers premium comfort and style at an accessible price, delivering great value without compromising quality.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers comfortable, with feet not hurting during wear, and appreciate their appearance, receiving many compliments. Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Comodidad absoluta para caminar todo el día y soporte excelente
Compré estos tenis Skechers buscando un calzado blanco básico pero que realmente me ofreciera un buen soporte, ya que suelo pasar mucho tiempo de pie o caminando durante el día. La tecnología de la plantilla (Arch Fit) realmente se nota; el soporte en el arco del pie es fantástico y reduce muchísimo el cansancio. Son extremadamente suaves al caminar, como si flotaras. El diseño es limpio, clásico y combina con cualquier ropa casual. El producto aparece en la descripción como que se suele devolver con frecuencia. Mi experiencia personal mi hizo conservarlos, lo único malo según mi parecer es que al ser completamente blancos, requieren [limpieza constante / se ensucian fácil con el roce diario]. Si buscas unos tenis duraderos, estéticos y que cuiden la salud de tus pies o espalda al caminar, estos Skechers valen cada centavo. Vienen fieles a la talla.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Heavier and sportier than expected
    Reviewed in the United States on April 28, 2026
    Color: WhiteSize: 8
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is a good shoe so it gets 4 stars. Minus a star because it lists upper as canvas, but it's really a mix of canvas and rubber. That combo makes them look sportier than I want, and also makes them stiffer and heavier than than I want.

    That said it's a well constructed shoe and as such, guessing it will hold up well. I walked out of it a bit like I do Sketcher slip-on shoes (I don't even try them any more). But I was pleasantly surprised to see that each pair came with a pair of full-length laces. Although I didn't unpack the laces, I'm certain they will help keep them on better, and might make them visibly less sporty. But not enough to keep them. The extra stitching meets the canvas upper adds extra seams inside the shoe that rub the sides of my feet. I ordered a 7.5M and 8M. Both felt the same in length on my foot. The 7.5 arch was in a better place, but the toe box was tighter. Considered a 7.5W, but a) about $40 more and they will still be just as heavy with extra seams on the inside. If you don't have "princess and the pea" feet like mine, I still give them 4 stars for good arch support and potential durability. Two more pair will be in stock soon :)

About this Item

  • PODIATRIST-CERTIFIED SUPPORT: Arch Fit insole system provides exceptional arch support, developed from 120,000 foot scans for optimal comfort in these slip on shoes for women
  • EASY SLIP-ON DESIGN: These slip on sneakers for women feature a convenient No Tie Fit design with tied-off laces that never come untied
  • PREMIUM COMFORT FEATURES: Removable insole molds to your foot while the lightweight cushioned midsole reduces shock and increases weight dispersion for these womens slip on shoes
  • VEGAN-FRIENDLY CONSTRUCTION: Canvas upper and 100% vegan materials make these fashion sneakers both stylish and environmentally conscious
  • VERSATILE STYLE: Flexible traction outsole and casual design make these perfect for everyday wear, from running errands to all-day comfort

Product Description

Experience ultimate comfort with these slip on shoes for women from Skechers. The Arch Fit Arcade Meet Ya There sneakers feature podiatrist-certified arch support and a canvas upper with tied-off laces for easy wear. Perfect for those seeking stylish womens slip on shoes with premium comfort features, these vegan-friendly sneakers offer a lightweight cushioned midsole and flexible traction outsole for all-day wear.
